values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: 6 km point-to-point fuel-oil line between Samawa Refinery and the Samawa Combined-Cycle Power Plant, both sited at Samawa, Al-Muthanna governorate; no official GIS route located, endpoints only (straight-line basis).

researcher_notes: Two independent, mutually corroborating sources confirm this is a real, completed (not proposed) pipeline: (1) Iraq Business News (English, 2025-04-08) reporting the Oil Pipelines Company brought online a 6 km, 6-inch fuel-oil line from Samawa Refinery to the Samawa Combined-Cycle Power Plant, replacing tanker-truck delivery; (2) qaissqb.com (Arabic, matching the operational date of 7 April 2025 given in-article: 'طول الأنبوب يبلغ 6 كيلومترات وقطره 6 عقدة' -- pipe is 6 km long and 6 inches diameter), naming the same operator (شركة خطوط الأنابيب النفطية / Oil Pipelines Company) and identical route/spec. A third Arabic hit (an Instagram post by samawa.news) cited '5كم' (5 km) but is not an independent written news outlet and is discounted in favor of the two matching 6 km figures from established news sites -- flagging the minor length discrepancy for awareness, not as a blocker. Re-checked against the 86-row existing Iraq roster in discovery_context.json: no row references Muthanna, Samawa, or any refinery-to-power-plant pair in that governorate, confirming this is genuinely missing, not a rename of an existing PID. Add-threshold met: (a) sponsor identified -- Iraq's state Oil Pipelines Company (subsidiary of the Ministry of Oil, per the same owner convention used on the analogous existing rows Ahdeb–Wassit P5292/P5293, Strategic Pipeline-Musaiab P6254, Strategic Pipeline-Al-Khairat P6258); (b) country + concrete endpoints -- Iraq, Samawa Refinery to Samawa Combined-Cycle Power Plant, Al-Muthanna governorate; (c) concrete step -- already operating/completed as of April 2025, the strongest possible status, not a rumor. Entity check: entity_lookup.py found no existing distinct 'Oil Pipelines Company' or 'SCOP' owner entity in the oil tracker (only a generic 'Oil' fuzzy hit), so Owner/Parent were set to 'Iraq Ministry of Oil [100.%]' / 'Ministry of Oil (Iraq) [100.00%]' to match the established convention for this exact class of refinery/pipeline-to-power-plant row rather than minting a new owner string. Route: no GIS/official map found for this short link; RouteAccuracy set to 'low' (endpoints known, straight-line only, both facilities co-located at Samawa). Confidence tier: high -- two independent outlets in two languages, consistent spec and operator, operating status confirmed rather than proposed.
